The backend has no en-route status or doctor position; the steps follow CONFIRMED, CHECKED_IN and COMPLETED only.
24 h / 12 h refund figures are fixed in the screen while the doctor page reads them from /system-config/public; online appointments (type 'online') ask for clinic slots when rescheduling.
The seeded patient has no active prescription, so the doctor, spec, date, diagnosis, labs and notes fields were not seen at runtime.
It sent nothing and is removed; voice messages would be a feature.
The camera on/off control already existed here and in /room/[id] and is kept; the calls decision of PROGRESS_ARCHIVE says to add none.
The 35 s timeout calls reject from inside a state updater, which can fire twice; signalling was not touched.
The board shows fee and points rows; the confirm form states the price at the payment step, so none is drawn.
